# Roadmap Prioritization

Read live issue and project state: Status, Priority, Target release, labels,
parent/child links, and blocking relationships. The tracker is authoritative;
roadmap documents explain rationale only. Prefer incidents and security,
structural fixes, planning blockers, release blockers, failing tests,
maintenance, then new features. Parallelize only without dependency or file
overlap. Report evidence and mismatches, and do not change scope without
explicit authorization.
